title: GIF cut-out masks compose: Add / Subtract over All / Frame / Selected, the image workspace's model
description: Fabio, 2026-09-20: masking a frame Background then By colour keeps only the last one, because every method calls setTrackMask and REPLACES the frame's track layer. The image workspace already solved this - a detect run renders green and waits for an explicit Add or Subtract (bakeAutoPicksInto). Port that: every method (BiRefNet included) becomes a source, the existing All / Frame / Selected scope says where it lands, and Mask becomes Add + Subtract. Clear already exists. Engine half shipped as MPI-858 (a cut intersects with the frame's own alpha).
